name: Homoveratrylamine
summary: 3,4-Dimethoxyphenethylamine (DMPEA or 3,4-DMPEA), also known as homoveratrylamine, 3-desmethoxymescaline, or O,O-dimethyldopamine, is a psychoactive drug and alkaloid of the phenethylamine family found naturally in humans as well as in cacti such as peyote (Lophophora williamsii), among many others.

pharmacology.text: DMPEA shows activity as a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist in the isolated rat aorta and rat stomach fundus strip (A2 = 4,370 nM and similar potency as mescaline for the latter). It has been found to induce the release of norepinephrine. The drug has some activity as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI).
pharmacology.kind: Psychoactive drug; Stimulant; Possible psychedelic drug

body.says: Thought to be low due to rapid metabolism

summaryZh: 3,4-二甲氧基苯乙胺是一種有機化合物，分子式C10H15NO2，和3-甲氧基酪胺一樣都可以看作是神經遞質多巴胺的同系物，其3號位和4號位的羥基被甲氧基取代，最早由A. Pictet和M. Finkelstein從香草醛合成。
